title: Introducing conductor mode in Kiro Crew
text: As the engineering team for Kiro Crew, working with AI agents lets us develop different parts of a feature in parallel. We start with a plan, then refine the requirements as we review prototypes and test the experience. Recently we have been developing a new feature to add the ability for an agent to drive a browser window, which we’ll refer to as browser usage. Those refinements during our own testing expanded its capabilities to include more browser controls, a live view in chat, and a testing function for finished work.
